cards.card_text: The Spirit of adoption to sonship A spirit of service under the law A spirit of courage for the battle
cards.verse_text: For you did not receive a spirit of slavery that returns you to fear, but you received the Spirit of adoption to sonship, by whom we cry, “Abba!
